name: Ace Work
description:
Most companies have no idea how their own work gets done. Processes live in people's heads, SOPs go stale the day they're written, and nobody logs the workarounds that keep things running.

Ace Work fixes that. Connect it to Claude and your workflow documentation becomes something you talk to instead of a wiki nobody reads.

What you can do:

- Capture new workflows in conversation. Claude interviews you about how a process really works and files it into your workspace, no forms, no blank templates.
- Run any documented SOP step by step, with Claude walking you through the checklist and pulling in your other connected tools to do the actual work.
- Log reality as it happens: how long a run really took, where you deviated from the documented process, and the friction points that slow you down. Everything lands as pending suggestions for human review, never silent edits.
- Search and read your company's workflow library, scoped by company, division, and department.

Every run makes your documentation more honest. That's the point: SOPs that reflect how work actually happens, not how someone hoped it would.

Built by Ace Workflow. We fix work.

https://aceworkflow.io

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ace Work to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ace Work to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://work.aceworkflow.io/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ace Work MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ace Work lists 18 MCP tools, including add_note, flag_pain_point, get_active_company, get_active_division, get_discovery_agenda, get_workflow, get_workflow_checklist, list_companies, list_departments, list_divisions, log_deviation, and log_time_taken.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ace Work?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Ace Work in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Ace Work MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ace Work requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Ace Work is developed by Ace Workflow INC.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
